messages:
Leah: Heads-up: after the kernel selector change + enabling microbatch hint we observed a weird pattern: decode GPU time down 30% but host p50 increased for tiny streams.
Tom: Can you share the profiler from the ingress sidecar?
Leah: quick breakdown: 
```
host ingress cpu:
- utf8 normalization + tokenize: 41%
- http2 frame parsing: 19%
- small write syscalls: 15%
- kvcache find: 9%
- batching controller: 8%
- misc: 8%
```
Ibrahim: that UTF8 chunk really jumped. any change to the streaming framing?
Leah: yes we enabled microbatch hint that tries to flush at sentence boundaries. It increased small writes.
Tom: small writes = more syscalls which show up as tail noise. We should coalesce writes inside sidecar when streaming is enabled.
Ibrahim: I can add a coalescer that buffers up to 4KB or 5ms whichever hits first. Should cut syscall rate for short streams.
QA-Bot: regression test: streaming-small-payloads shows 22% fewer syscalls with local coalescer.
Leah: good. propose combined plan: 1) turn on write coalescer in sidecar for canary, 2) land tokenizer fastpath (reuse buffers), 3) expose a kernel-selection metric so we can see when fused path is chosen and correlate host CPU.
Tom: also add endpoint to let infra toggle header canonicalization per-client. disabling for internal clients gave 3% win in my bench.
Ibrahim: will file PR for coalescer and add tunables for max-latency and max-bytes.
Leah: timeline: PRs by EOD, canary flip tomorrow. QA to run streaming-tail tests overnight.
QA-Bot: nightly streaming-tail test queued. will report back in morning.
